tasks.title: Classify counting and whole numbers
tasks.objective: Distinguish between counting (natural) numbers and whole numbers.
tasks.scope: Zero, positive integers, negative integers and positive half-integers. Counting starts at 1; classify membership in both sets.

tasks.title: Name an arithmetic operation
tasks.objective: Identify four fundamental operations of arithmetic.
tasks.scope: All four operations, one per variant; enter its name.

tasks.title: Name the parts of arithmetic
tasks.objective: Identify and name the parts of addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division problems.
tasks.scope: All operand/result positions for all four operations, including repeated addend/factor roles.

tasks.title: Write dollars and cents
tasks.objective: Express dollars and cents correctly.
tasks.scope: Whole-cent amounts from 1 to 99,999 cents, including single-digit cents; dollars require $ and exactly two decimal places, cents require ¢.

tasks.title: Evaluate a variable expression
tasks.objective: Evaluate an expression with variables when the variables are assigned specific values.
tasks.scope: Three expression forms over x=2–12, y=2–9, z=2–8; includes grouping, multiple variables and exact fractional results.

tasks.title: Multiply whole and decimal numbers
tasks.objective: Multiply with whole and decimal numbers.
tasks.scope: Whole 12–999 times 12–99; exact hundredths amount 0.11–9.99 times tenths amount 1.1–9.9. Decimal-only response for decimal multiplication.

tasks.title: Divide a decimal by a whole number
tasks.objective: Divide with whole number divisors and decimal number dividends.
tasks.scope: Whole divisors 2–25; nonintegral decimal dividends constructed from exact thousandths quotients. Exact decimal answer.

tasks.title: Give remainder or mixed-number division answers
tasks.objective: Divide with whole number divisors and dividends where the quotient requires a remainder or fraction.
tasks.scope: Divisors 3–19 and quotients 2–99, nonzero remainder below divisor; alternating quotient-R-remainder and reduced mixed-number response.

tasks.title: Identify an operation property
tasks.objective: Identify the properties of operations.
tasks.scope: Commutative and associative addition/multiplication, distributive multiplication over addition, additive/multiplicative identity and zero multiplication; identify the property.

tasks.title: Write an example of an operation property
tasks.objective: Illustrate the properties of operations.
tasks.scope: Same property roster; write a complete numeric equality with given digits/order. Both equality directions accepted; bounded grammar, not unrestricted symbolic equivalence.

tasks.title: State a sequence rule and continue it
tasks.objective: Determine a pattern or rule for a sequence and then apply the rule to continue the sequence.
tasks.scope: Increasing/decreasing constant-step sequences; report the signed step and next three terms.

tasks.title: Write a commutative example
tasks.objective: Illustrate the commutative property of addition or multiplication by giving an example involving specified digits.
tasks.scope: Commutative addition/multiplication with two distinct specified digits; write a complete equality.

tasks.title: Write an associative example
tasks.objective: Illustrate the associative property of addition or multiplication by giving an example involving specified digits.
tasks.scope: Associative addition/multiplication with three distinct specified digits, preserving their order; write a complete equality.

tasks.title: Show a subtraction or division counterexample
tasks.objective: Illustrate why the associative and commutative properties do not apply to the operations of subtraction or division.
tasks.scope: Evaluate both sides of four counterexample forms: subtraction/division, commutative/associative; unequal results illustrate failure. Worked solution explains the conclusion.

tasks.title: Solve a one-operation equation
tasks.objective: Find the value of a variable in addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division equations.
tasks.scope: All four operations, either operand unknown; positive integer operands and results, nontrivial multiplication/division.

tasks.title: Find a missing addend
tasks.objective: Find a missing addend in an equation or number sentence.
tasks.scope: Unknown addend in either position, exact integer answer.

tasks.title: Find a missing factor
tasks.objective: Find a missing factor in an equation or number sentence.
tasks.scope: Unknown factor in either position, factors at least 2.

tasks.title: Find a missing minuend or subtrahend
tasks.objective: Find a missing minuend or subtrahend in an equation or number sentence.
tasks.scope: Both missing minuend and missing subtrahend, positive integer differences.

tasks.title: Find a missing dividend or divisor
tasks.objective: Find a missing divisor or dividend in an equation or number sentence.
tasks.scope: Both missing dividend and missing divisor, quotient at least 2.

tasks.title: Compare and order points on a number line
tasks.objective: Compare and order numbers on a number line.
tasks.scope: Read three marked integer points on a -10 to 10 number line; order all three and compare A with B.

tasks.title: Compare signed whole numbers
tasks.objective: Use comparison symbols to compare numbers.
tasks.scope: Integers from -100 to 100, including negatives, zero and explicit equality branches; enter <, > or =.

tasks.title: Add and subtract on a number line
tasks.objective: Add and subtract integers on a number line.
tasks.scope: Start -5 to 5; add/subtract positive or negative 1–5 with plotted start, directional arrow and ticks. Result stays within -10 to 10.

tasks.title: Name a place through hundred trillions
tasks.objective: Identify the place value of digits in whole numbers to hundred trillions.
tasks.scope: All 15 place positions through hundred trillions, repeated/zero digits and explicit standalone zero; target digit identified by position from the left.

tasks.title: Write expanded notation
tasks.objective: Write whole numbers in expanded notation.
tasks.scope: Whole numbers through 999,999,999,999,999, including zero places and standalone zero; descending nonzero place-value sum, or 0.

tasks.title: Write whole numbers in words
tasks.objective: Read and write whole numbers through hundred trillions in word form.
tasks.scope: Whole numbers through 999,999,999,999,999 and zero; write English words, accepting hyphens and optional and.

tasks.title: Write whole numbers from words
tasks.objective: Use digits to express numbers through hundred trillions.
tasks.scope: The same range in words; write digits with optional correctly grouped commas.

tasks.title: Find a digit value
tasks.objective: Identify the value of a digit in a given place value by multiplying the digit by its place value.
tasks.scope: Digit value = digit × positional multiplier across all 15 positions; zeros explicitly included.

tasks.title: List every factor
tasks.objective: Identify all the factors of a number.
tasks.scope: Every positive factor of integers 1–120; ordered list including 1, primes, composites and squares.

tasks.title: Find the greatest common factor
tasks.objective: Identify the greatest common factor (GCF) of two numbers.
tasks.scope: GCF of two integers 2–120, including equal inputs and relatively prime pairs.

tasks.title: Apply a divisibility rule
tasks.objective: Test for the divisibility of 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, and 10 without performing the division.
tasks.scope: Numbers 1,000–999,999 and all divisors 2,3,4,5,6,8,9,10; yes/no plus last digit, last two/three digits or digit sum; divisor 6 requires both last digit and digit sum.
